purpose: Read-only species-selection evidence, NOT a training manifest or accuracy evaluation.

filters.time_window: all time; counts as returned during retrieval

query_completeness: All ten responses returned exactly total_results rows; no pagination omitted.
region_definition: U.S. Census Bureau Northeast: New England (CT, MA, ME, NH, RI, VT) plus Middle Atlantic (NJ, NY, PA). Broome County is a separate local diagnostic, already inside NY; never added to regional totals.
ranking_rule: Missing supported taxon IDs/names, sorted by nine-state summed observation count descending, taxon_id ascending for ties. Broome count is context, not an extra weight.
shortlist_status: PROVISIONAL: counts rank relevance, not label reliability, photo usability, licensing, deduplicated sample availability, or model performance. Admit fewer than 15 if readiness fails.
caveats: Observation counts are not independent individual ants, unique photos, natural abundance, encounter probabilities, or accuracy.
Research-grade sampling favors photographable and identifiable taxa; zeros do not prove absence.
Aggregate counts do not apply training/benchmark/calibration/test exclusions or photo-license/duplicate checks.
No observation/photo records or image files were downloaded for this snapshot.
A taxon's occurrence count is not an endorsement of every underlying identification.
iNaturalist taxonomy and aggregate counts can change after this dated retrieval.
